name: Sage Tofauti
role: Blackmail specialist and information broker for petty leverage
location: Gravesend Basin, operates out of a water-damaged apartment above the Pelican Fry stall on Sump Row, near Halsted and Division
description:
Sage Tofauti has the patient, watchful quality of someone who has learned to make herself invisible. She is medium height, with deep amber skin, close-cropped natural hair she dyes a muted copper, and wide-set eyes fitted with patterned irises—concentric rings of gold and black that she uses deliberately to unsettle people when she removes her tinted contacts in negotiation. Her hands are always busy: folding receipts, tapping rhythm on surfaces, smoothing the worn edges of her data chips. She dresses in forgettable browns and grays, functional layers that carry no corporate logo and make no statement. She could be a transit worker, a clinic scheduler, a nobody. That is entirely the point.

Sage Tofauti is methodical and almost affectless in conversation, communicating through implication rather than declaration. She has a talent for making people feel that confessing to her is the only rational choice, and she genuinely believes she provides a service—she rarely destroys anyone, preferring the sustainable income of ongoing compliance. She has a private moral line: she will not leverage people over things that could get them killed or trafficked. She's broken that rule once, and she knows it, and it follows her.

core_fears: Becoming what she did that one time—someone who got a person killed for money
Being truly seen and found contemptible
core_desires: Control over her own circumstances and safety
To believe she operates within a personal code that holds
coping_mechanisms: Ritual organization of her workspace and data
Deflecting personal questions with information about the asker
blind_spots: She underestimates how much her subjects resent her even when they comply
She believes her self-imposed rules make her fundamentally different from worse operators
psychology.secret: Three years ago she sold leverage on a Tier 1 debtor to a loan shark who used it to locate the man's sister for organ harvesting. She did not know that would happen. She has never worked with that buyer again but has never reported it either, and the guilt has calcified into a private doctrine of 'harm reduction' that lets her keep working.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Flat, precise, slightly bureaucratic. Uses passive constructions to avoid assigning blame. Rarely raises her voice.
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow and deliberate, with long comfortable pauses she does not feel the need to fill.
verbal_tics: Repeating a word from what you just said back to you as a question
example_lines: 'I'm not asking you for anything you don't already know I have. I'm asking you to make a reasonable decision.'
'People say all kinds of things when they feel cornered. I'm not cornering you. There's no corner here. Sit down.'

story_hooks: One of her current leverage subjects has been murdered, and the killer left her data chip at the scene—she needs someone to quietly find out who is burning her network before the Basin enforcers connect the chip to her

She holds information about a mid-level Tessera facilities manager that has just become explosively relevant to a larger situation she did not anticipate, and she needs to decide whether to sell it, bury it, or use it as protection
narrative_function: Quest giver for leverage-based missions, source of personal dirt on mid-tier NPCs, moral complication—sympathetic operator with a past transgression she can't undo.
augmentations: Patterned irises (concentric gold-black rings, cosmetic). Sub-dermal data storage nodes in left forearm—three chips' worth, consumer grade. Auditory filter implant that lets her isolate voices in crowd noise.
daily_life: Spends mornings reviewing scraped data feeds and monitoring her subjects' public activity; afternoons making rounds of the Basin markets under the guise of casual shopping, collecting gossip and confirming intelligence before making any contact.
affiliation: Independent operator, loose arrangement with the Sump Row merchants' protection collective

decision_rules: Never confirm what you have until the other party has confirmed they want to negotiate
Exit any situation where violence becomes likely—money is not worth injury
escalation_ladder: State plainly and let silence do the work
Introduce a specific detail that proves the depth of her knowledge
State a concrete deadline and consequence, then leave

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Polite, attentive, faintly unreadable—asks questions and offers almost nothing
interpersonal_modes.friends: Warmer but still careful, expresses care through practical help rather than words

stress_responses.low: Increased organizational rituals, reorders her chips and notes
stress_responses.medium: Goes quiet and watchful, stops initiating conversation
stress_responses.high: Leaves. Physically removes herself and does not communicate until she has a plan.

contradictions: Believes strongly in personal codes of conduct but built her livelihood on exploiting others' failures to maintain theirs
habits: Arrives fifteen minutes early to any meeting and maps the exits
Keeps a physical logbook in a personal cipher—doesn't trust cloud storage for anything sensitive
breaking_points: If anyone moves against someone she has quietly decided to protect
If her private rule gets broken again—she will fold entirely

cyberware_inventory.name: Sub-dermal data storage array (left forearm, 3-node, consumer grade)
cyberware_inventory.description: Sub-dermal data storage array (left forearm, 3-node, consumer grade)

cyberware_inventory.name: Auditory isolation filter (medical-consumer crossover, slightly illegal install)
cyberware_inventory.description: Auditory isolation filter (medical-consumer crossover, slightly illegal install)

timeline.event: Age 19: Left Gravesend Basin's public housing block after her mother's UBC stipend was garnished by a fraudulent debt collector—first exposure to leverage as a weapon
Age 23: Began freelance work compiling dossiers for a Basin loan operation, discovered she was better at collecting than the collectors
Age 31: The incident with the organ harvester buyer
Age 32: Went fully independent, severed the loan operation connection, established current practice

physical_description.heritage: Pacific Islander dominant (52.9%, primarily Polynesian), Southeast Asian (24.1%), Sub-Saharan African (14.3%), East Asian (5.4%), and Hispanic/Latin American (3.3%) ancestry. The blend manifests in warm deep bronze skin with golden undertones, high prominent cheekbones characteristic of Polynesian lineage, refined facial structure showing Southeast Asian and East Asian heritage influences, and elegant angularity from the full ancestral combination. Features are fine-boned and economical.
physical_description.build: Lean and compact, economical in movement. Shoulders slightly narrow, core tight from decades of controlled posture. No visible musculature, but the kind of wiry endurance that comes from constant low-level motion rather than deliberate conditioning.
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped, faded at temples, kept very short to minimize grooming maintenance and avoid being grabbed
physical_description.eye_color: Augmented: concentric rings of deep gold and obsidian black (cosmetic iris implants). Natural color unknown—hazel beneath the modification
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm deep bronze with golden undertones, sun-darkened from years in the Basin's outdoor markets. The tone carries the richness of Pacific Islander, Southeast Asian, and Sub-Saharan African ancestry blended together, creating luminous depth with subtle warm radiance rather than flat darkness.
physical_description.complexion: Fine-featured with high prominent cheekbones inherited from Polynesian ancestry, refined by Southeast and East Asian heritage influences creating elegant angularity. The facial bone structure shows the subtle blending characteristic of Pacific Islander-Southeast Asian heritage with refined undertones from East Asian genetics. Skin is clear but weathered—not from sun damage but from low-grade environmental stress, early stress lines around the eyes from constant surveillance work. Minimal makeup. A very slight asymmetry to her left jaw from an old break that healed without proper setting.
distinguishing_marks: Small burn scar on the inner right wrist, roughly 2cm diameter, shaped like a cigarette cherry—received during interrogation in 2219, deliberately inflicted, deliberately visible as a reminder

Three thin parallel scars running vertically along the left forearm below the elbow, barely visible unless she extends her arm in certain light—surgical marks from data node installation, partially healed with cosmetic sealant

A faded tattoo on the nape of her neck, Polynesian geometric pattern no larger than a postage stamp, barely visible beneath her close-cropped hair—family marking from her mother's side, kept hidden from most people
physical_description.visible_augmentations: The augmented irises are immediately visible when she makes eye contact or removes her tinted contacts—the patterned gold-and-black rings are distinctive and unsettling. The sub-dermal data storage nodes in her left forearm are not visible beneath clothing, but if her sleeve rides up during conversation, faint linear scars from the implant sites can be seen. The auditory filter implant is completely invisible—no external hardware, no tells.
physical_description.posture_movement: Sits with her spine straight but not rigid, hands always occupied—folding, tapping, smoothing. Her gaze moves constantly but without the jerky quality of anxiety; it's methodical, cataloging. She moves through spaces with minimal energy expenditure, taking up as little room as possible. When she walks, her feet land heel-to-toe in an almost silent pattern. Speaks quietly, requiring people to lean in slightly to hear her, which puts them off-balance.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4–5 working class, deliberately forgettable. Worn earth tones: taupe, warm gray, faded olive. Layered functional pieces—a thin jacket over a long-sleeved shirt, often with an unbuttoned overshirt for weather adaptability. Everything is from discount chain retailers or secondhand markets, nothing with visible branding. Her clothing carries the minor stains and repairs of someone who prioritizes durability over appearance. Worn sneakers or practical boots, always lace-up for quick escape. No jewelry except a battered data chip on a thin steel chain around her neck—the 'insurance copy,' kept close.
